title: Two Young Farm Boys in Overalls & Caps, 1930s Rural Americana Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of two young boys standing closely together in an open grassy pasture or agricultural field. The boy on the left wears a buttoned knit cardigan sweater over a collared shirt, trousers, and a snug dark cap, joyfully holding his right arm raised with an index finger pointed toward the sky. The boy on the right wears dark denim bib overalls over a dark sweater and a tilted newsboy cap, gazing forward toward the camera. Their practical attire reflects working-class rural American childhood during the Great Depression to pre-WWII era. The reverse bears a single blue photofinishing printer stamp reading 'A 1 6'.
